Commentary.Commentary: That's it from us today. India clinch another victory in this competition and qualify for the knockouts. They look a tough side to beat as both their batting and bowling look strong. It will take something extraordinary to beat this side. India now face Zimbabwe on 19th January, Friday. Tune in at 1400 local (0100GMT) for live action. Until then, goodbye and take care!

India skipper, Prithvi Shaw says that they were relaxed after facing a tough opponent in the first match. Adds that the boys gave their best with good intensity on the field and with the right attitude. States that it has always been about the process and not the result. On being asked about the management, he says that the support staff and trainers help them remain fit all the time. He specially mentions that it is an honour for the team to have Rahul Dravid as the coach and they are not thinking about the qualification now (as they have already qualified). Ends by saying that they want to learn from every match and keep improving.

Papua New Guinea skipper, Vagi Karaho says that it was a good learning experience for them as for most of the boys it was the first time that they were playing in a World Cup. Adds that they have learned a lot. He even mentions that all the coaches and support staff have helped them get so far. About their preparation coming into the tournament, he says that they went to Brisbane to prepare themselves but it was challenging for them.

Anukul Roy is the Man of the Match in today's game for his match-winning figures of 6.5-2-14-5. He says that the playing conditions looked pretty decent and it was cold out there. Informs that their physio and trainers asked them to stretch and keep themselves warm. On being asked about his confidence going into the game, he replies that he was getting into good rhythm and that gave him confidence.

They then came out with one intention - Finish the game early and get enough sleep. Prithvi Shaw led from the front and came out firing on all cylinders. He scored a quick fire-fifty, his second in two games. His partner, Manjot just faced nine balls but didn't mind being at the other end seeing his captain dominate proceedings. Papua New Guinea, on the other hand, couldn't do much with the ball as they were low on confidence defending a below-par score. Hopefully, they take something from this game and come out fighting in the next one.

We all knew the result of this game before the start of it. But who knew it would be over in this fashion? India have not only won this game but have humbled their opponents. They have finished the game in just eight overs with all of their wickets intact. India took about 4-5 overs to get a hang of the track but after that it was no stopping them. Earlier, they bowled out PNG for just 64 runs with Roy picking up a fifer.
FOUR! That's a 10-wicket victory for India. Length ball outside off, Shaw slaps this over the cover region to get it past the fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Another fifty for Shaw. Two in a row. Full delivery on the legs, he clips it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary to bring up his fifty in style. The captain is leading from the front.
Fullish delivery outside off, Kalra opens the face of the bat to get the ball towards the point fielder and they take a single.
Tau bowls a full delivery outside off, Kalra drives it to the cover-point fielder.
Full and drifting down the legs, Shaw flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Kalra punches it towards the mid off region and the batsmen change strike.
FOUR! Shaw looks to be in hurry. A full delivery on the stumps, Shaw lofts it over the mid off region to earn another boundary to his name. That sounded good as it came of the bat.
Full outside off, Shaw hits the drive straight to the cover fielder.
Beaten. Morea pitches it on a good length spot outside off, Shaw goes for the drive but gets beaten by it.
FOUR! A full toss on the leg stump, Shaw chips it over the square leg region for another boundary. He is making it look very easy. Had he timed that well he would have got a maximum.
Short and wide outside off, Shaw hangs back and hits it over the point region. The batsmen come through for a brace.
A low full toss outside off stump, Kalra plays it to the cover region and they pick up a single.
Leke Morea comes into the attack.
FOUR! Surely he is in a hurry to finish this. Maybe also looking to get to his half century. Pitched up again and Shaw comes down the track to smack it over mid off for another boundary.
Outside off, Kalra guides it to third man for one.

DROPPED! They have dropped the Indian skipper here. Does well to get to the ball catches it but the ball pops out after that. Overpitched ball, Shaw looks to loft it over the mid off region but the ball flies to the fielder stationed there. He runs backwards to reach the ball but cannot manage to stick to it. They run through.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time, beautifully played. Length ball on leg, Shaw gets in line and flicks it away through mid-wicket for a boundary. He surely favors this leg side.
Pitched up on the pads again and Shaw cannot find the gap. Hits it straight to square leg.
On the legs of Shaw who flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
FOUR! Another boundary. This time on the on side. Outside off, Shaw opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Runs coming easily for India. Pitched up ball on leg and Shaw flicks this away through mid-wicket for another boundary. Perfect head position and well in control of that.
Short ball, Shaw tries to hook this but misses.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, Shaw guides this to third man for another run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Drags this slight back, in line of the stumps, Kalra goes back and punches it on the off side for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Shaw. Similar ball and similar shot. Pitched up again and Shaw gets to the ball and flicks it away at the last moment through mid-wicket again for another boundary.
FOUR! Even better! Gets the second boundary of the over. Pitched up ball, on middle and leg, Shaw whips it away through the mid-wicket region for another boundary.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Shaw connects well this time. Nice shot. Length ball outside off, Shaw cuts it through backward point and the ball races away for a boundary.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Wide outside off stump, Shaw leaves it alone.

FOUR! Beautifully done! Everything good about that. Slightly over pitched, invites Manjot for the drive and gracefully accepts it. Not the fastest of balls, Karla waits for it and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Better from Shaw. Gives the strike to Manjot. Outside off, guides this to third man for one.
No timing from Shaw. He is trying to hit the ball too hard. Pitched up ball, Shaw leans forward and looks to drives this past covers. Just manages to get an inside edge to it onto the pads.
Pitched up, Shaw doesn't connect with this and it goes to the mid off fielder.
Fullish delivery outside off, Shaw goes for a drive but gets a thick inside edge towards mid on.
Fullish delivery on leg stump, played with soft hands to square leg.
James Tau to bowl from the other end.
Well bowled! On a length outside off, Shaw pokes at it but gets beaten. A fumble from the keeper allows the batsmen to take a bye.
Fractionally overpitched, driven hard but finds the man at short cover.
FOUR! Sublime! Back of a length outside off, Shaw stands tall and punches it firmly through covers to find the fence.
Full and well outside off, Shaw doesn't fiddle with it.
India are away! Very full around the boots, tucked nicely behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Overpitched delivery on off, Shaw leans ahead and times his drive sweetly to mid off.
We are back for the chase. Prithvi Shaw and Manjot Karla to open the batting for India. Sema Kamea to start off the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
